summary:
Credit Manager with 7+ years of progressive experience in credit appraisal, loan underwriting, and portfolio
management across retail, MSME, corporate, and agricultural segments. Proven expertise in financial statement
analysis, credit risk assessment, and policy compliance. Recognized with the Rising Star Award at CSB Bank for
exceptional performance. Strong ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, train employees, and improve
credit processes.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Working Capital→Working Capital Financing(100%), Mortgage Loans→Mortgage Lending(100%), Financial Statement→Financial Reporting(97%), Risk Mitigation→Risk Management(100%))

bullets: Appraised credit proposals worth ₹3 Crore, including working capital, agriculture Mortgage, and term & subsidy loans with a strong focus on Agriculture B2B and B2C segments.
Managed a credit portfolio of ₹86 Crore, ensuring timely renewals and maintaining superior asset quality.
Carried out PD and field visits for credit assessment, verifying customer profile and business viability.
Coordinated with valuation, legal teams to validate documents, ensuring compliance, timely loan sanction
Conducted financial analysis, CIBIL/CRILC checks, internal ratings, and risk assessments.
Reduced credit appraisal TAT 40% by streamlining CMA preparation& verification processes.
Trained new employees in credit policies, product knowledge in collaboration with L&D team
Monitored NPA accounts and suggested risk mitigation strategies.
Awarded Rising Star (Nov 2023) for outstanding performance.
Analyzed MSME and corporate loan proposals and prepared CMA reports.
Coordinated with RM’s & reduced TAT through efficient documentation, process tracking.
Prepared sanction letters, ensured compliance with regulatory and internal credit norms.
Developed MIS dashboards and shared updates with senior management.
Handled affordable housing, business, and agriculture loan segments.
Conducted customer discussions, home visits, and repayment capacity evaluations.
Monitored NPA customers and supported collections through corrective actions.
Trained junior officers on updated credit policies and processes.
Processed mortgage and working capital loans with complete financial due diligence.
Conducted CMA preparation, financial ratio analysis, and appraisal memos.
Performed credit checks using CIBIL, CRILC, GST, PAN, NCLT, and fraud control systems.
Coordinated risk activities and ensured timely processing within TAT.
Managed personal and business loan, KYC checks, CIBIL verification and underwriting.
Analyzed bank statements and salary slips to calculate credit eligibility.
Coordinated field verification, disbursals, MIS reports and fraud control activities.
